source: NPR 等主流新闻 RSS（每日自动更新）

articles.title: This high-speed star is whipping around the black hole in the middle of our galaxy
articles.summary: 天文学家发现迄今观测到的最快恒星 S301，它正以每秒超过 1.5 万英里的速度绕银河系中心的超大质量黑洞运行，为研究黑洞如何扭曲时空提供了绝佳"探针"。

sentences.en: Researchers have identified a speed demon at the heart of the Milky Way.
sentences.zh: 研究人员在银河系中心发现了一颗"速度恶魔"般的恒星。

sentences.en: This fast-moving star may yield insights into the black hole parked at the center of our galaxy.
sentences.zh: 这颗高速运动的恒星或许能让我们深入了解盘踞在银河系中心的黑洞。

sentences.en: In the fall of 2002, scientists calculated the mass of a truly gargantuan entity at the heart of our Milky Way galaxy.
sentences.zh: 2002 年秋天，科学家测算出银河系中心一个真正庞然大物的质量。

sentences.en: It was four million times the mass of our Sun — so big it almost certainly had to be a supermassive black hole.
sentences.zh: 它的质量是太阳的 400 万倍——大到几乎肯定是一个超大质量黑洞。

sentences.en: Black holes are, by their very nature, yawning enigmas — their gravitational pull is so powerful that not even light can escape.
sentences.zh: 就其本质而言，黑洞是令人费解的谜——它们的引力如此之强，连光都无法逃脱。

sentences.en: In new research published in the journal Nature on Wednesday, Gillessen and his colleagues describe the fastest star ever observed.
sentences.zh: 在周三发表于《自然》期刊的新研究中，吉勒森和同事描述了迄今观测到的最快恒星。

sentences.en: Gillessen says that what is important about the discovery isn’t the star’s speed — but rather its proximity to the black hole.
sentences.zh: 吉勒森说，这项发现的关键在于恒星的速度——而在于它离黑洞的距离。

sentences.en: Thereby we can use the star as a probe to visualize how gravity is acting on space and time.
sentences.zh: 因此我们可以把恒星当作探针，来直观展现引力如何作用于空间和时间。

sentences.en: Despite their gravitational dominance in the universe, researchers still have rather basic questions about black holes.
sentences.zh: 尽管黑洞在宇宙中占据引力主导，研究人员对它们仍有一些相当基础的问题。

sentences.en: We want to understand how black holes work and how black holes influence their direct environment.
sentences.zh: 我们想弄清楚黑洞如何运作，又如何影响它们周围的直接环境。

sentences.en: And if you want to know about black holes, the center of the Milky Way is the best laboratory we have.
sentences.zh: 如果你想了解黑洞，银河系中心就是我们手头最好的实验室。

grammar: so...that... 结果状语从句：例："It was four million times the mass of our Sun — so big it almost certainly had to be a supermassive black hole." so 后接形容词 big，that 从句表示结果（大到几乎肯定是超大质量黑洞）。
现在完成时 have identified：例："Researchers have identified a speed demon at the heart of the Milky Way." 强调过去动作对现在造成的影响（已经发现）。
破折号表补充说明：例："Black holes are, by their very nature, yawning enigmas — their gravitational pull is so powerful..." 破折号后解释黑洞为何是谜。
what 引导的名词性从句作主语：例："what is important about the discovery isn’t the star’s speed — but rather its proximity to the black hole." what 从句整体作主语，isn’t...but rather... 表"不是……而是……"。
情态动词 may + 动词原形表推测：例："This fast-moving star may yield insights into the black hole..." may 表示可能性。
不定式 to visualize 表目的：例："...we can use the star as a probe to visualize how gravity is acting on space and time." 不定式说明"用作探针"的目的。

articles.title: Many recent grads say AI is making it harder to get a job. Economists aren’t so sure
articles.summary: 不少应届大学毕业生认为 AI 抢走了入门级岗位，但经济学家指出原因更复杂——年轻人失业率虽略高于整体，却未必全是 AI 之过。

sentences.en: Irene Chang, 21, studied engineering in college because she enjoys solving problems.
sentences.zh: 21 岁的艾琳·张在大学学工程，因为她喜欢解决问题。

sentences.en: She also wanted to major in something she thought would lead to a stable career.
sentences.zh: 她也希望主修一个她认为能带来稳定职业的专业。

sentences.en: Chang graduated in May from Georgia Tech with a bachelor’s degree in industrial and systems engineering.
sentences.zh: 张于今年 5 月从佐治亚理工学院毕业，获得工业与系统工程学士学位。

sentences.en: She says she started applying for entry-level data analyst roles about a year ago, while she was still in school.
sentences.zh: 她说自己大约一年前、还在校时就开始申请入门级数据分析师岗位。

sentences.en: Chang estimates she has submitted around 450 applications since last September and has had about 19 interviews.
sentences.zh: 张估计自去年 9 月以来她投了约 450 份申请，参加了约 19 场面试。

sentences.en: Jacqueline Kline, 25, is in the same boat.
sentences.zh: 25 岁的杰奎琳·克莱恩处境相同。

sentences.en: She graduated this past spring from Florida State University with a master’s degree in communications.
sentences.zh: 她今年春天从佛罗里达州立大学毕业，获得传播学硕士学位。

sentences.en: So far, she says, she has applied to more than 500 entry-level jobs since last December.
sentences.zh: 她说，自去年 12 月以来，她已申请了 500 多个入门级职位。

sentences.en: Both Kline and Chang say they think AI may be part of the reason that finding a job in their respective fields has been such a challenge.
sentences.zh: 克莱恩和张都认为，AI 可能是她们在各自领域求职如此艰难的部分原因。

sentences.en: According to the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, the unemployment rate for recent graduates was 5.7% as of June.
sentences.zh: 据纽约联邦储备银行数据，截至 6 月，应届毕业生的失业率为 5.7%。

sentences.en: Many of those recent graduates think AI is to blame for their employment struggles.
sentences.zh: 许多应届毕业生认为，AI 是他们就业困境的罪魁祸首。

sentences.en: This year, in a survey from ZipRecruiter, 47% of them said AI had already affected hiring in their field.
sentences.zh: 今年 ZipRecruiter 的一项调查中，47% 的人表示 AI 已经影响了他们所在领域的招聘。

grammar: because 引导原因状语从句：例："Irene Chang studied engineering in college because she enjoys solving problems." because 说明主句动作的原因。
现在完成时 has submitted / has had：例："Chang estimates she has submitted around 450 applications... and has had about 19 interviews." 强调动作从过去某时持续到现在的结果。
that 引导定语从句（省略关系代词）：例："...something she thought would lead to a stable career." 省略了 that/which 的定语从句修饰 something。
in the same boat 习语：意为"处境相同；同病相怜"。例："Jacqueline Kline is in the same boat." 指她也面临同样的求职困境。
be to blame 固定搭配：例："Many of those recent graduates think AI is to blame for their employment struggles." be to blame 表示"应受责备／是……的起因"。
介词短语 as of + 时间：例："...the unemployment rate for recent graduates was 5.7% as of June." as of 意为"截至……"。
过去完成时 had affected：例："47% of them said AI had already affected hiring..." 表示在过去某动作（said）之前已发生的事。

articles.title: The U.S. debt tops a record-shattering $40 trillion. Yes, with a T
articles.summary: 美国联邦债务突破 40 万亿美元创历史新高，政府每年举债超 2 万亿，仅利息支出就超过 1 万亿，推高了所有人的借贷成本。

sentences.en: The U.S. government’s accumulated debt has reached a record $40 trillion, according to a daily update from the Treasury Department.
sentences.zh: 据财政部每日更新，美国政府的累积债务已达到创纪录的 40 万亿美元。

sentences.en: The federal debt topped $40 trillion Wednesday, a new high-water mark for red ink that shows no sign of receding.
sentences.zh: 联邦债务在周三突破 40 万亿，这是赤字的新高点，且毫无消退迹象。

sentences.en: The government continues to pile up debt at a rapid clip, as spending outstrips revenue by more than $2 trillion a year.
sentences.zh: 政府继续以飞快速度堆积债务，因为支出每年比收入高出 2 万亿美元以上。

sentences.en: Our current fiscal trajectory is plainly unsustainable, and that’s the best-case scenario.
sentences.zh: 我们当前的财政轨迹显然不可持续，而这还是最乐观的情况。

sentences.en: The deficit widened further after the Supreme Court struck down many of President Trump’s tariffs.
sentences.zh: 在最高法院推翻特朗普总统的许多关税后，赤字进一步扩大。

sentences.en: Government revenues have grown 3% this fiscal year — but spending has grown even faster.
sentences.zh: 本财年政府收入增长了 3%——但支出增长得更快。

sentences.en: The government is spending more than a trillion dollars a year just to pay interest on the mounting debt.
sentences.zh: 政府每年花在偿还不断攀升的债务利息上的钱就超过一万亿美元。

sentences.en: Interest is now the government’s second-biggest expense, trailing only Social Security.
sentences.zh: 利息如今是政府的第二大支出，仅次于社会保障。

sentences.en: Interest costs in the first 10 months of this fiscal year were 15% higher than they were in the same period a year ago.
sentences.zh: 本财年前 10 个月的利息支出比一年前的同期高出 15%。

sentences.en: The yield on 30-year Treasurys reached a 19-year high this week.
sentences.zh: 本周 30 年期国债收益率达到了 19 年来的最高点。

sentences.en: That raises borrowing costs for everyone else, since mortgage rates and other interest rates often follow long-term Treasurys.
sentences.zh: 这提高了其他所有人的借贷成本，因为房贷利率和其他利率往往跟随长期国债变动。

sentences.en: Federal debt is already raising the cost of living and choking out other spending and investment.
sentences.zh: 联邦债务已经在推高生活成本，并挤压了其他支出与投资。

grammar: 现在完成时 has reached / have grown：例："The U.S. government’s accumulated debt has reached a record $40 trillion." 强调已到达的现有状态。
as 引导原因状语从句：例："...as spending outstrips revenue by more than $2 trillion a year." as 此处表原因"因为"。
现在分词 showing 作后置定语：例："...a new high-water mark for red ink that shows no sign of receding." showing 修饰 mark，说明其特征。
strike down 短语动词（被动）：例："The Supreme Court struck down many of President Trump’s tariffs." strike down 意为"否决；推翻"（法律/政策）。
现在分词 trailing 作状语：例："Interest is now the government’s second-biggest expense, trailing only Social Security." trailing 表示"仅次于"。
since 引导原因状语从句：例："That raises borrowing costs for everyone else, since mortgage rates... often follow long-term Treasurys." since 表原因。
比较级 + than 比较结构：例："Interest costs... were 15% higher than they were in the same period a year ago." higher than 表示"高于……"。

articles.title: Why Aitana’s ‘Superestrella’ is the surprise Latin hit song of the summer
articles.summary: 西班牙歌手 Aitana 的《Superestrella》横扫西语世界、登顶 Billboard 拉丁榜，这首带着复古派对气质的情歌，恰好为经历艰难一年的拉美听众提供了逃避现实的慰藉。

sentences.en: "Superestrella" is pretty close to perfect pop.
sentences.zh: 《Superestrella》几乎是一首完美的流行歌。

sentences.en: Its catchy hook, syrupy, love-filled lyrics and a resonant drum beat make it tailor-made for head-bopping.
sentences.zh: 它洗脑的副歌、甜腻而充满爱意的歌词，以及共鸣感十足的鼓点，让它天生适合跟着点头摇摆。

sentences.en: It’s an almost early-2000s party song, about falling for a cute guy in the club, even if doing so might be a mistake.
sentences.zh: 它几乎是一首 2000 年代初的派对歌，讲述在俱乐部里爱上帅气男生，即便那样做可能是个错误。

sentences.en: But despite its song of the summer magnetism, the way it has swept most of the Spanish-language world is still a bit surprising.
sentences.zh: 但尽管它有"年度之歌"的魅力，它横扫大部分西语世界的方式仍有些令人意外。

sentences.en: The song is over a year old, released by the Spanish artist Aitana on her fourth album, 2025’s Cuarto Azul.
sentences.zh: 这首歌已经发布一年多，由西班牙歌手 Aitana 在她的第四张专辑、2025 年的《Cuarto Azul》中推出。

sentences.en: The Latin Grammy-winning singer from Catalonia first gained notoriety for her time on a local music competition TV show.
sentences.zh: 这位来自加泰罗尼亚、拿过拉丁格莱美的歌手，最初因参加一档本地音乐选秀电视节目而走红。

sentences.en: "I never imagined that ‘Superestrella’ could go so far and connect with so many people outside Spain," Aitana told Billboard.
sentences.zh: "我从没想过《Superestrella》能走这么远，还能打动西班牙以外的这么多人，" Aitana 对 Billboard 说。

sentences.en: Historically, Spain’s pop has been mostly created and championed within the country.
sentences.zh: 从历史上看，西班牙的流行音乐大多是在本国创作并受到推崇的。

sentences.en: But there is something uniting about "Superestrella" this summer.
sentences.zh: 但今年夏天，《Superestrella》有着某种凝聚人心的力量。

sentences.en: I have heard it blaring out of tienditas and World Cup watch parties, where Aitana performed the song during Spain’s official World Cup victory celebration.
sentences.zh: 我听到它从街角小店和世界杯观赛派对里轰鸣传出——Aitana 曾在西班牙官方的世界杯夺冠庆祝活动中演唱这首歌。

sentences.en: The region has experienced a difficult year, from natural disasters to political upheaval.
sentences.zh: 这一地区经历了一年艰难时光，从自然灾害到政治动荡。

sentences.en: "It’s not easy to fall in love with a superstar," Aitana belts on her heart-thumping chorus.
sentences.zh: "爱上一位超级巨星并不容易，" Aitana 在她令人心跳加速的副歌里有力唱道。

grammar: make + 宾语 + 形容词（宾语补足语）：例："Its catchy hook... make it tailor-made for head-bopping." make 后接宾语 it 和形容词 tailor-made 作补语。
even if 引导让步状语从句：例："...even if doing so might be a mistake." even if 表示"即使"。
despite + 名词短语：例："But despite its song of the summer magnetism, the way it has swept..." despite 后接名词，表让步。
现在完成时 has swept / has experienced：例："...the way it has swept most of the Spanish-language world..." 强调从过去到现在的持续影响。
过去分词 winning 作定语：例："The Latin Grammy-winning singer..." winning 修饰 singer，表示"获奖的"。
where 引导非限制性定语从句：例："...World Cup watch parties, where Aitana performed the song..." where 指代地点 parties。
直接引语与引号嵌套：例："It’s not easy to fall in love with a superstar," Aitana belts... 引语内用单引号标注歌名。

articles.title: Australia and New Zealand send over 240 firefighters to help battle U.S. wildfires
articles.summary: 美国遭遇破坏性野火季，消防资源逼近极限，澳大利亚和新西兰派出史上最大规模队伍跨国驰援——两国有着长达二十年的消防员互援传统。

sentences.en: A destructive wildfire season is pushing American firefighting resources to their limits.
sentences.zh: 破坏性的野火季正把美国的消防资源推向极限。

sentences.en: Australia and New Zealand have sent their largest contingent ever to help out.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚和新西兰派出了史上规模最大的队伍前来援助。

sentences.en: On Monday alone, the National Interagency Fire Center counted 147 new fires across the country.
sentences.zh: 仅周一一天，国家跨部门消防中心就统计到全国新增 147 起火灾。

sentences.en: More than 29,000 personnel have been assigned to fight them.
sentences.zh: 已有超过 2.9 万名人员被调配去扑救。

sentences.en: U.S. fire officials are desperate for support, so they’re turning to other countries for help.
sentences.zh: 美国消防官员急需支援，因此正转向其他国家求助。

sentences.en: More than 240 firefighters from Australia and New Zealand are outside on the campus of the National Interagency Fire Center in Boise, Idaho.
sentences.zh: 来自澳大利亚和新西兰的 240 多名消防员聚集在爱达荷州博伊西的国家跨部门消防中心园区外。

sentences.en: They’re all experienced firefighters, but steering wheels, for example, are on the opposite side over here.
sentences.zh: 他们都是有经验的消防员，但比如方向盘在这里是在另一侧。

sentences.en: This group joins a smaller contingent of Australians and New Zealanders who arrived earlier this month.
sentences.zh: 这支队伍加入了本月早些时候抵达的一支规模较小的澳新队伍。

sentences.en: Now more than 300 are fighting large blazes across the West.
sentences.zh: 如今有 300 多人在西部各地扑救大火。

sentences.en: It is absolutely the largest contingent Australia and New Zealand have provided to the U.S. at any one time.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是澳新两国在任何时候向美国派出的最大规模队伍。

sentences.en: We’re in the dormant stage of our winter, and we have the skill and resources.
sentences.zh: 我们正值冬季的休眠期，而且我们拥有技术和资源。

sentences.en: So far, more than 7 million acres have burned, the highest figure in at least a decade.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，已有超过 700 万英亩土地被烧毁，这是至少十年来的最高数字。

grammar: 现在完成时 have sent / have been assigned / have burned：例："Australia and New Zealand have sent their largest contingent ever to help out." 强调动作结果持续到现在。
on Monday alone 中 alone 的用法：例："On Monday alone, the National Interagency Fire Center counted 147 new fires." alone 意为"仅仅；单是"，表强调。
so 引导结果状语从句：例："U.S. fire officials are desperate for support, so they’re turning to other countries for help." so 连接因果。
who 引导定语从句：例："...a smaller contingent of Australians and New Zealanders who arrived earlier this month." who 修饰人。
现在进行时 are fighting：例："Now more than 300 are fighting large blazes across the West." 现在进行时表正在进行的动作。
最高级 + 范围（in + 时间段）：例："...the highest figure in at least a decade." 最高级后接 in 短语表示比较范围。
but 并列转折：例："They’re all experienced firefighters, but steering wheels... are on the opposite side." but 连接对比。

articles.title: Greetings from Trouville-sur-Mer, a beach town little changed since Monet painted it
articles.summary: 法国诺曼底海滨小镇特鲁维尔距巴黎仅两小时火车，却仿佛隔世——海风、碎石路、印象派画家莫奈笔下的海滩景致，百年来几乎未变。

sentences.en: Normandy beach town has hardly changed since Monet painted it.
sentences.zh: 这座诺曼底海滨小镇自莫奈描绘它以来几乎未曾改变。

sentences.en: The Normandy beach town of Trouville-sur-Mer is just a two-hour train ride from the center of Paris, but it feels a world away.
sentences.zh: 特鲁维尔-梅尔这座诺曼底海滨小镇距巴黎市中心仅两小时火车车程，却让人感觉相隔一个世界。

sentences.en: Gone are the heat and traffic of the city, replaced by English Channel breezes and the sound of seagulls screeching through the cobbled streets.
sentences.zh: 城市的炎热与车流消失了，取而代之的是英吉利海峡的微风，以及海鸥在鹅卵石街道间尖鸣的声音。

sentences.en: The beaches along this expanse of coastline known as the Norman Riviera are wide, with big tides.
sentences.zh: 沿着这片被称为"诺曼底里维埃拉"的海岸线，海滩宽阔，潮差很大。

sentences.en: Many Parisians come up just for the day, relaxing in chaise lounge chairs under colorful beach umbrellas that line the boardwalk.
sentences.zh: 许多巴黎人只是来度个一日游，在排列在木板步道旁、色彩缤纷的 Beach 伞下的躺椅上放松。

sentences.en: The Impressionists captured Trouville’s sandy beaches and shifting skies.
sentences.zh: 印象派画家捕捉了特鲁维尔的沙滩与变幻的天空。

sentences.en: Fashionable holiday makers began taking to the waters here in the 19th century in what was known as "sea bathing."
sentences.zh: 时髦的度假者从 19 世纪起就开始在这里下水，当时这被称为"海水浴"。

sentences.en: Looking at one of Claude Monet’s Trouville-sur-Mer beach scenes of turreted houses and fashionable boardwalk strollers, it feels like nothing has changed since then.
sentences.zh: 看着克劳德·莫奈笔下特鲁维尔海滩的景象——带塔楼的房屋与时尚的步道漫步者，感觉自那时起一切都没变。

grammar: but 并列转折：例："...it is just a two-hour train ride from the center of Paris, but it feels a world away." but 连接对比。
完全倒装 Gone are...：例："Gone are the heat and traffic of the city..." 表语 gone 前置引起主谓倒装，强调消失的事物。
过去分词 replaced 作后置定语：例："...replaced by English Channel breezes..." replaced 修饰前面名词，表被动。
现在分词 relaxing 作伴随状语：例："Many Parisians come up just for the day, relaxing in chaise lounge chairs..." relaxing 表示伴随动作。
定语从句 that line the boardwalk：例："...colorful beach umbrellas that line the boardwalk." that 修饰 umbrellas。
in what was known as... 名词性从句：例："...in what was known as ‘sea bathing.’" what 从句作介词 in 的宾语。
现在分词 Looking 作状语：例："Looking at one of Claude Monet’s... beach scenes, it feels like nothing has changed..." looking 表时间/条件状语。

articles.title: How extreme weather could help predict disease outbreaks
articles.summary: 一项新研究显示，巴西一场百年一遇的干旱可能助长了黄热病蔓延——理解极端天气与传染病的关联，或能帮助人类提前预测并防范疫情爆发。

sentences.en: A historic drought may have helped yellow fever spread in Brazil.
sentences.zh: 一场历史性的干旱或许助长了黄热病在巴西的传播。

sentences.en: A new study shows how understanding the connection could help prepare for future outbreaks.
sentences.zh: 一项新研究展示了理解这种关联如何能帮助为未来的疫情爆发做准备。

sentences.en: Long droughts, flash floods, hurricanes — scientists say human carbon emissions are making extreme weather like this more common and more severe.
sentences.zh: 长期干旱、暴洪、飓风——科学家说，人类碳排放正让这类极端天气变得更常见、更严重。

sentences.en: Researchers like the makers of this recording at the Muriqui Project of Caratinga noticed that endangered monkeys were dying by the hundreds.
sentences.zh: 像卡拉廷加穆里基项目里制作这段录音的研究人员一样，有人注意到濒危猴子正成百地死去。

sentences.en: Before long, humans started to get sick, too.
sentences.zh: 不久，人类也开始生病。

sentences.en: It was the first case of urban yellow fever in about a century.
sentences.zh: 这是大约一个世纪以来首例城市黄热病。

sentences.en: Jamie Caldwell is a Princeton ecologist who uses data models to understand how infectious disease spreads.
sentences.zh: 杰米·考德威尔是一位普林斯顿生态学家，她用数据模型来理解传染病如何传播。

sentences.en: As there was deforestation in the Amazon, you would start to see the disease move southeastward.
sentences.zh: 随着亚马逊地区森林被砍伐，你会开始看到这种疾病向东南方向移动。

sentences.en: There is a highly effective yellow fever vaccine, but because the virus is so rare in Brazilian cities, many people didn’t get it.
sentences.zh: 有一种非常有效的黄热病疫苗，但因为病毒在巴西城市里极为罕见，许多人并未接种。

sentences.en: More than 740 people died between 2016 and 2018.
sentences.zh: 在 2016 至 2018 年间，有超过 740 人死亡。

sentences.en: Yellow fever is spread by mosquitoes, so floods can increase the risk of an outbreak.
sentences.zh: 黄热病由蚊子传播，因此洪水会增加疫情爆发的风险。

sentences.en: Fewer mosquitoes should mean fewer infections.
sentences.zh: 更少的蚊子应该意味着更少的感染。

vocab.zh: 突发的；迅猛的（flash flood 暴洪）

grammar: may have + 过去分词（情态动词表对过去的推测）：例："A historic drought may have helped yellow fever spread in Brazil." may have helped 推测过去可能发生的事。
how 引导宾语从句：例："A new study shows how understanding the connection could help prepare for future outbreaks." how 从句作 shows 的宾语。
破折号列举：例："Long droughts, flash floods, hurricanes — scientists say..." 破折号前列举极端天气类型。
as 引导原因状语从句：例："As there was deforestation in the Amazon, you would start to see the disease move southeastward." as 表原因。
but + because 复合：例："There is a highly effective yellow fever vaccine, but because the virus is so rare..., many people didn’t get it." but 后接 because 从句。
so 引导结果：例："Yellow fever is spread by mosquitoes, so floods can increase the risk of an outbreak." so 连接因果。
fewer + 复数名词比较级：例："Fewer mosquitoes should mean fewer infections." fewer 修饰可数名词复数，表"更少的"。
